title: Remove production timeout dependence from the control unwind diagnostic test
outcome: The lost-reply diagnostic regression test verifies correlated queued and fatal records without depending on one-second production exit budgets.
acceptance: Prime build identity and drain the diagnostic sink with the test RECORD_DRAIN before serving the injected unwind and before reading records.
Retain producer equality, terminal refusal, correlated fatal record and exact-key canonical-object replay assertions; focused coverage passes.
